purpose: Repair the R25 fail-open edge authorization: the R25 edge verdict was status=FAIL (boundary +0.641pp, partial -0.961pp) at single-prompt n=312 (thin sample = within-prompt noise over ONE needle's layer/step records), yet the OLD artifact writer authorized radix-on by reading only the eviction subcase. R26 reruns the edge probe at ROBUST n (statistical unit = needle, >=128 matched, paired off/fresh vs on/reuse) so the verdict honestly reflects the original +/-0.5pp-clean contract, then regenerates the v2 artifact with the ALREADY-FIXED fail-closed writer (write_v2_artifact.py, which reads the edge verdict's own status/problems).
op_point: TP=8 / fp8_e4m3 / page 64 / mem 0.8 / max-running 64 / cuda-graph-max-bs 64 / EAGER (--disable-cuda-graph) for edge probes; expandable_segments NEVER set (PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF unset)
ds_table_free_config: top_k 2048, page_size 64, channel_mask /models/glm51-fp8-channel-mask-s256.safetensors (sha256 340b6c0bd40d6d7dcf4fef5ab2a9f096cf56d94bc844960500bcd72db65f08bd), device_buffer_size 4096, scorer_norm off, head_agg max, anchor off, recall_oracle true (edge probes)

harness_reused.prompt_path: test/manual/test_double_sparsity_v32.py helpers (_niah_needle / _make_niah_prompt) + DS recall oracle sink (oracle_artifact_sink set_active_trial/clear_active_trial)
harness_reused.proven_cache_engaging: development/loop11/runs/20260616_r25/l4096_highn (L1024 same-seed warmup seeds the shared radix prefix -> cached_tokens 320-640) + radix_authorization/probes/p1_recall
harness_reused.fixed_writer: development/loop11/runs/20260616_r26/edge_repair/write_v2_artifact.py (FAIL-CLOSED; reads each gate verdict's own status/problems; refuses unless all PASS)

new_harness_under_run_dir: edge_highn_driver.py (per-arm robust-n edge sweep: cold OFF-control + boundary/partial/eviction ON; per-request cached_tokens captured)
analyze_edge.py (per-needle paired delta vs cold + bootstrap CI + per-arm cache-engagement proof; emits gate_c_edge_verdict.json with status/problems)
run_gate_c.sh (one-server-at-a-time driver: OFF boot for cold, ON boot for the three on-arms; reuses r25_env)

gate_c_method.statistical_unit: needle (NIAH trial); per-needle recall@2048 = fraction of that needle's oracle records with recall_at_k[2048]; paired by needle idx to the cold/fresh control
gate_c_method.robust_n: >=128 matched needles per on-arm (run at num=144)
gate_c_method.cold_control: radix-OFF boot (--disable-radix-cache); cached_tokens MUST be 0 (clean control)
gate_c_method.boundary: radix-ON; L1024-iN same-seed warmup then measured L4096-iN reuses aligned prefix pages; cached>0 AND %64==0
gate_c_method.partial: radix-ON; warmup L4096-iN then re-request with a short appended tail so divergence falls mid-page; aligned pages reused + partial page recomputed; cached>0
gate_c_method.eviction: radix-ON; warm prefix, flush_cache, re-request P -> recompute; cached MUST fall to 0; recall == cold (deterministic recompute = no stale slot)
gate_c_method.pass_rule: status=PASS iff boundary & partial mean paired recall delta vs cold within +/-0.5pp AND eviction recompute == cold (mean delta within +/-0.5pp) with cached fallen to 0; engagement PROVEN per arm from raw cached_tokens
